announcement.SChinese:
🎑 1.1.1 更新啦！

模组市场
• 支持从直链安装模组
• 下载完成后会自动解压 ZIP、RHP 或 DLL，并可导入已有整合包或新建整合包后导入

整合包
• 模组列表标题栏新增「全选 / 取消全选」
• 仅对当前筛选结果中可见的模组生效，可一次启用或禁用多个模组

游戏内
• 全新悬浮日志样式，标题更加清晰
• BepInEx 日志级别和对应堆栈信息会根据级别自动着色
• 日志自动滚动到最新一行
• 优化日志图标和最小化按钮，移除多余底色

修复
• 限制崩溃弹窗高度，仅日志正文滚动，标题和按钮始终保持在屏幕内
• 公告和更新弹窗同样限制在屏幕范围内
• 加强 ARM64 原生 Hook，减少短函数和连续 Hook 导致的原生崩溃
• 再次启动游戏时使用新的游戏进程，不再复用异常进程
• 崩溃记录增加更多游戏进程日志和进程退出原因，方便排查闪退

语言
• 更新 Crowdin 翻译
• 新增和完善印尼语、西班牙语、马来语、泰语、威尼斯语、阿拉伯语、阿拉伯语（埃及）、马拉雅拉姆语、葡萄牙语、葡萄牙语（巴西）、乌克兰语、土耳其语、俄语、荷兰语、韩语、日语、意大利语、德语、法语等语言

🌕 祝大家游玩愉快！
🥮 中秋节快乐！✨
announcement.English:
🎑 Version 1.1.1 is here!

Mod Market
• Added support for installing mods directly from URLs
• ZIP, RHP, and DLL files are automatically extracted after downloading and can be imported into an existing modpack or a newly created modpack

Modpacks
• Added Select All / Deselect All to the mod list toolbar
• Only mods visible in the current filter are affected, allowing multiple mods to be enabled or disabled at once

In-game
• Redesigned the floating log window with a clearer title
• BepInEx log levels and their corresponding stack traces are automatically color-coded
• Logs automatically scroll to the latest entry
• Removed unnecessary backgrounds from the log icon and minimize button

Fixes
• Limited the height of crash dialogs so only the log content scrolls while the title and buttons remain visible
• Announcement and update dialogs are also constrained to the screen
• Improved native Hook handling on ARM64 to reduce crashes caused by short functions and consecutive Hooks
• The game now starts with a fresh process instead of reusing an abnormal process
• Crash reports now include more game process logs and the process exit reason for easier troubleshooting

Languages
• Updated Crowdin translations
• Added and improved Indonesian, Spanish, Malay, Thai, Venetian, Arabic, Arabic (Egypt), Malayalam, Portuguese, Portuguese (Brazil), Ukrainian, Turkish, Russian, Dutch, Korean, Japanese, Italian, German, and French translations

🌕 Have fun playing!
🥮 Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! ✨
